summary: Unexpected reserve credit reallocation after hourly batch reroute causing mid-cycle invoice variance
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports a mid-cycle invoice variance where hourly reserve credits previously allocated to AstraWave's dedicated capacity were partially reallocated to a different cost center after an automatic batch reroute.
Impact: Customer sees ~12% reduction in apparent reserved-hour credits on provisional invoice; visible increase in hosted fallback charges for the same timeframe. Affects financial reconciliation for month-end.
Environment: Dedicated tenant (AstraWave), reserved pool 'dw-astrawave-prod', prod | us-east, mixed-model microbatching with scheduled warmup.
Steps to reproduce / observed sequence: 1) Scheduled multi-model batch at 02:00 UTC used both mix-3b and mix-7b-quant. 2) Autoscaler triggered a reroute at 02:03 UTC due to transient GPU shortage; scheduler redirected a subset of microbatches to fallback pool and tagged postbacks with an internal reroute tag. 3) Postback reconciler replayed hourly accumulators at 02:10 UTC. 4) Provisional invoice at 03:00 UTC shows reserve credits reduced for customer and a hosted fallback line charged under a different cost center.
Observed behavior: Reserve buffer credits were deducted from AstraWave's reserved allocation and applied to a generic 'fallback-burst' ledger. Postbacks contain reroute metadata but the reconciler appears to have dropped the original tenant tag in a subset of messages.
Expected behavior: Rerouted work should consume fallback capacity but reserve credits for the originating tenant should remain credited against their reserved hours for the hour window (or be reflected as a clear fallback consumption that the customer can reconcile).
Business impact: Customer cannot reconcile MTD spending vs. their reserved commitment; accounting is preparing internal chargebacks. Customer requests provisional credit and an explanation of root cause and mitigation steps.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run scheduled multi-model microbatch for dedicated tenant. 2) Trigger autoscale reroute to fallback pool (simulate GPU shortage). 3) Allow postback-reconciler to process hourly accumulators. 4) Inspect provisional invoice and hourly reserve credit allocation for the affected hour.

comments: Priya Sharma (Support): Opened on customer report; requested provisional invoice export and raw postback files from customer.
Customer (AstraWave Billing): Provided provisional invoice and list of job ids for 02:00-03:00 UTC; requesting immediate provisional credit while investigation runs.
Marco Nguyen (SRE): Noted reconciler logged a partial_fail on replay for acc-7745; assigned to postback-reconciler team for deeper trace.
Emily Park (Billing eng): Pulling ledger attribution logs; initial sign shows tenant_tag missing on ~8/67 postback entries for the hour.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Postback-reconciler replay path strips tenant tags when reroute tag present due to legacy normalization rule introduced in 2025-11 deployment.
Hypothesis 2: Scheduler appended reroute metadata that exceeded message size and reconciler truncated last field (tenant tag). Edge case on multiformat payload.

Evidence: Reconciler error entry 'partial_fail dropped_fields=[tenant_tag]' matches timeframe. Replayed postback batches show consistent reroute tag 'reroute:fallback-burst' and absent tenant field in 12% of events.
Temporary mitigation considered: Force reconciler to re-run with raw accumulator and override mappings to reassign credits back to original tenant until fix is deployed.
customer_communication: 2026-03-14 Priya Sharma: Confirmed receipt of customer's job list and informed them we are escalating to engineering. Offered provisional credit cover pending root cause and audit.
2026-03-14 AstraWave Billing: Accepted provisional credit request; asked for ETA on permanent fix and whether this could recur on other reroutes.
resolution:
Workaround/Provisional: Billing agreed to apply a provisional manual credit of the affected delta (~$4,150) to AstraWave's account for this invoice cycle while engineering runs a verified reconciliation job.
Fix plan: Postback-reconciler team will push a hotfix that preserves tenant_tag for replayed accumulators and adds a regression test for reroute-tagged payloads. Scheduled deploy to canary 2026-03-16 and full roll on 2026-03-17.
Follow-up: After fix, run a reconciliation replay for 2026-03-14 02:00-03:00 UTC window, confirm ledger corrections, and update customer with detailed runbook entry. Also add alert to reconciler when dropped_fields is non-empty for accumulation replays.
next_steps: SRE: Run targeted reconciler re-run with raw accumulator exports and repair tenant attribution (assigned Marco Nguyen).
Billing: Apply manual provisional credit and annotate invoice line with 'investigation-provisional-credit' (assigned Emily Park).
Postback-reconciler eng: Prepare hotfix branch and regression tests; coordinate canary deploy 2026-03-16 (assigned Juliette Chen).
CS: Schedule post-resolution call with AstraWave to walk through findings and remediation timeline (assigned Priya Sharma).
public_note: Provisional credit applied pending root-cause reconciliation. Engineering investigation in progress; no change to SLA status but billing variance acknowledged and customer notified.
